en.headline: Tai Po estate block loses water and lifts after pipe leak
en.dek: More than 670 households at Kwong Chi House in Kwong Fuk Estate were without running water and lift service after a leak in the underground pump room.
body: More than 670 households at Kwong Chi House in Tai Po's Kwong Fuk Estate lost running water and lift service on Tuesday evening after a pipe leaked in the block's underground pump room.

District councillor Lo Hiu-fung, citing the management company, said a contractor was sent to carry out emergency repairs. Bottled water was handed out in the lobby, and a ground-level standpipe near the block was opened so residents could collect water. The Water Supplies Department sent a water wagon to the estate at about 9:35pm to provide a temporary supply.

The management company expected part of the domestic supply to return in the early hours of Wednesday. Both lifts were damaged and needed replacement parts, and the contractor said the earliest they could resume service was Wednesday.
The outage left residents of the public-housing block carrying water upstairs overnight while repairs continued.

zh.headline: 大埔廣福邨廣智樓喉管漏水 逾670戶停水停𨋢
zh.dek: 廣智樓地下水喉房喉管漏水，大廈緊急停水並暫停升降機，區議員引述管理公司指部分食水料凌晨恢復，𨋢最快周三修復。
body: 大埔廣福邨廣智樓周二傍晚地下水喉房有喉管漏水，大廈需要緊急停水並暫停升降機服務，超過670戶居民受影響。
大埔區議員羅曉楓引述管理公司表示，承辦商已到場搶修。管理處在大堂向有需要住戶派發樽裝水，並開放廣智樓附近地喉供居民取水。水務署晚上約9時35分安排水車到場，提供臨時食水。
管理公司初步預計，部分單位的食水供應要到周三凌晨才恢復。兩部升降機受事故影響需要更換零件，承辦商表示最快要到周三才能恢復服務。
搶修期間，住戶要自行搬運用水上樓。管理公司及水務署未有公布漏水原因。
